evidence: Modifies src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.{cpp,h}, src/kernel/bitcoinkernel_wrapper.h, and src/bitcoin-chainstate.cpp to update the kernel C and C++ logging APIs.
rationale: Establishes context-attached logging in the kernel C API before downstream consumers depend on the current interface. As the author notes, the primary goal is to change the public API before code builds on it, enabling #30342 to supply separate log output per context.
